durable_demo.boundary: A free Render service runs the private candidate source as staging for a private pilot, not as production. Redeployed by hand from main at 7a4756a on 2026-11-02 and rechecked that day: /version reporting 2.13.0 at that commit, /health/ready with postgresql true and a 240-entry dictionary, the strict CSP and HSTS headers, painted scenes served under img-src 'self', and a Google OAuth redirect that starts correctly; a completed sign-in on this deploy has not been run. It runs in Frankfurt since 2026-09-12, when /health/live answered in 0.149 s and the session cookie was Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=lax. The free plan sleeps after 15 minutes and the wake-up varies (38.6 s and 218 s on the same day), so a first request can take minutes: wait before concluding it is down. The human Hebrew-content and first-learner gates remain open, no v2.12.3 or v2.13.0 tag exists, and the historical Railway service is offline.
